procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
GER 4600 was represented by Peter Weichsel (skipper).
DEN 41 was represented by Jonas Funk Pedersen (helm).
Zoe Coers (crew of GER 7262) gave evidence as a witness.
Stefan Meier (crew of GER 6400) gave evidence as a witness.
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident were less than 5 knots of wind and no waves.
In the last minute before the start of the of race 4 DEN 41 was approaching the starting line close-hauled on starboard tack.
GER 6400 was reaching along the starting line on port tack, one boat length leeward of the starting line.
DEN 41 was aiming behind the stern of GER 6400.
When the boats were one boat length apart GER 6400 bore away and established a collision course with DEN 41.
DEN 41 bore away sharply to a broad reach.
GER 6400 gybed onto starboard tack and established a windward overlap with DEN 41.
GER 6400 continued reaching down the line.
When the boats were on a reaching course the distance between the boats was less than 15 cm.
conclusions: GER 6400 on port-tack failed to keep clear of DEN 41 on starboard-tack, and broke RRS 10.
After the gybe GER 6400 to windward failed to keep clear of DEN 41 to leeward, and broke RRS 11.
When changing course, DEN 41 the right-of-way boat gave GER 6400 room to keep clear, and complied with her obligations under RRS 16.1.
